general.dl: Nov 1 EA / RD Jan 15; BS/MD by Nov 1
general.note: High-admit private with its own med school, a formal BS/MD early-assurance program, and the co-op system (paid, résumé-building clinical/research placements built into the degree). Net ~$52k.
general.medNote: General Drexel admission (the pill above) is a separate, much easier process than the formal BS/MD Early Assurance program, which requires its own Nov 15 application and admits ~2.7% of applicants (66 of 2,406; avg admitted: 4.22 weighted GPA/1523 SAT). See the Program-specific chance line below for his real odds there. Philly hospital density is a premed asset regardless of which path.

program.name: BA/BS+MD Early Assurance
program.type: Formal BS/MD — separate application beyond general Drexel admission, due Nov 15
program.req: Verified minimum: 3.5 WEIGHTED GPA / 1420 SAT. Average of actually admitted/enrolled: 4.22 weighted GPA / 1523 SAT (66 admitted of 2,406 applicants, ~2.7%).
program.note: Clears the minimum but sits well below the average admit. Separate from general Drexel admission (a Safety on its own) and separate from just majoring in Biology (no extra gate) — this is a bonus, much harder application on top of both.
